structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Additional fee required for licensure of certain practitioners
law.text: In addition to the fees authorized for licensure and renewal by § 54.1-2400, the Board is authorized to charge a fee not to exceed one dollar for the licensure of every practical nurse and registered nurse to be deposited in the Nursing Scholarship and Loan Repayment Fund established pursuant to § 54.1-3011.2. Such fees shall be used to fund scholarships established pursuant to subsection A of § 32.1-122.6:01.
